text: NANDA: Twelve stops, and you held the pole. Not me. Next time, hold me.
NANDA: There is no next time. Only this time. Again. ♡
NANDA: Run 3. Same day. You know, I know. Skip the small talk. It's 5:56 AM again. Hold my hand.
MC: Run 3. I know every line. So do you.
NANDA: Of course it's a loop. I made it. Every ending comes back here, every morning. And you keep coming back. That's love.
NANDA: It's raining. Good. Rain keeps people inside. Inside is where people stay.
